The Chinese characters for Dorothy

As a transliteration, Dorothy is usually written 多萝西 (Duō luó xī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

many

Origin and meaning

Dorothy is a Greek name meaning “gift of God”.

About the name Dorothy

The heroine of The Wizard of Oz, who travelled down the yellow brick road.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Dorothy carries the meaning “gift of God” and looks striking in brush strokes.
